name: Character sheet
description: One canonical description feeds a turnaround, an expression grid (split it with Quick Split) and an action pose.

nodes.title: Character — canonical description
nodes.prompt: Mara, 28, courier in a rainy cyberpunk city. Short silver bob, amber eyes, freckles, oversized yellow raincoat, black cargo pants, worn sneakers.

nodes.title: Turnaround
nodes.prompt: Character turnaround sheet: front, side and back views on a neutral grey background, identical lighting

nodes.title: Expressions 2×2
nodes.prompt: 2x2 grid of facial expressions: neutral, happy, angry, surprised; same framing

nodes.title: Action pose
nodes.prompt: Dynamic action pose sprinting across a neon-lit rooftop in the rain
